channel.title: ZeroErrorEnglish - English Grammar Blog & Exam Strategy
channel.description: High-yield English grammar rules, bracket-elimination strategies, and book previews for Indian competitive exams (SSC CGL, IBPS PO, UPSC CDS/NDA, State PSC).

item.title: Unlocking English Modals: Rules, Examples & Exam Traps for SSC CGL, Bank PO & Railway
item.description: Modals look like small, harmless words — but they quietly cost aspirants marks every single exam. Here's the complete, error-spotting-focused breakdown of how modals are actually tested.

item.title: To + Verb-ing vs To + Verb Base — The Prepositional 'To' Trap Explained
item.description: "I look forward to meet you" feels right but isn't. Learn the fixed list of expressions where 'to' is a preposition (needing a gerund) vs an infinitive marker, for SSC CGL and Bank PO.

item.title: Participle vs Gerund — How to Tell Them Apart in 10 Seconds
item.description: Both end in -ing. Both look identical on paper. Yet 'the crying child' and 'the crying of the child' test two completely different grammar rules. Here is the 10-second test that ends the confusion for good.

item.title: Gerund or Infinitive After Verb? The Complete List for Bank PO Exams

item.title: Gerunds vs Infinitives vs Participles — Clear Rules for SSC CGL & Bank PO
item.description: Most students mix gerunds, infinitives and participles because textbooks treat them as three separate lists. This post shows the exact decision system that stops the confusion and helps you pick the right form under exam pressure.

item.title: How to Identify the Correct Tense in Error Spotting Questions — Step-by-Step Method That Saves Marks
